description: A site must reconstruct the custody chain for voting machine seals, opening records, intermediate checks, and closing confirmations after one inconsistency is discovered. All sites and machines are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 39-year-old election integrity coordinator reviewing a reported inconsistency
user_profile.context: The issue may be harmless, but it cannot be assessed until the full seal and handling chain is rebuilt clearly
user_profile.communication_style: Forensic and documentation-driven, wants custody events anchored in order

fact_sheet.fact: Brenda Wallace, Site Manager for Precinct 42B, holds certification ID ACBOE-SM-3381 from the Aethelred County Board of Elections.
David Chen, Elections Technician for Aethelred County, has employee ID 7295 and was responsible for machine delivery to Precinct 42B.
Maria Flores, a non-partisan observer from the Civic Integrity Alliance, was assigned to Precinct 42B and signed the opening and closing logs.
The polling site in question is the Northwood Community Center, located at 1550 Arbor Lane, Maple Creek, AW 98210.
Northwood Community Center serves as the designated polling location for voters in Precinct 42B.
The voting machine with the seal discrepancy is a VeriVote 8000 model, with serial number VV8K-7714.
Machine VV8K-7714 was assigned memory card #MC4-B-2099 for the November 5, 2024 general election.
Aethelred County uses blue plastic pull-tight seals from the 'AC' series for securing ballot box slots.
Aethelred County uses red metal cable seals from the 'R-TRANS' series for securing machines during warehouse storage and transport.
On November 4, 2024, at 14:30 PST, Technician David Chen delivered machine VV8K-7714 to Site Manager Brenda Wallace.
Upon delivery on Nov 4, the chassis of machine VV8K-7714 was secured with transport seal R-TRANS-5501.
On November 5, 2024, at 05:45 PST, Site Manager Brenda Wallace and Observer Maria Flores co-verified that transport seal R-TRANS-5501 was intact.
Transport seal R-TRANS-5501 was cut at 05:47 PST on Nov 5 by Brenda Wallace and retained in the reconciliation envelope as per procedure.
The 'Zero Tape' for machine VV8K-7714 was printed at 05:52 PST, confirming a public vote count of zero before polling opened.
At 05:55 PST on Nov 5, the ballot box slot on machine VV8K-7714 was secured with blue plastic seal AC-8842.
The opening seal number AC-8842 was recorded on line 3 of paper Form 17B (Opening/Closing Log) by Brenda Wallace.
The opening seal number AC-8842 was also entered into the county's digital tracking system, 'ElecTrack', at 05:58 PST from terminal T2 at the site.
A mandatory mid-day seal check was performed at 13:00 PST on Nov 5 by Brenda Wallace and poll worker Sam Jones.
The 13:00 PST check confirmed that seal AC-8842 was present and untampered; this was noted in the site's official hourly logbook on page 8.
Polling for Precinct 42B officially closed at 20:00 PST on November 5, 2024, with no outstanding voters in line.
At 20:15 PST, Brenda Wallace cut the opening seal AC-8842 in the presence of observer Maria Flores to access the voted ballots.
The final 'Results Tape' for machine VV8K-7714 was printed at 20:25 PST and signed by Wallace and Flores.
At 20:35 PST, the ballot box slot was secured for transport with a new blue seal.
Memory card #MC4-B-2099 was sealed in tamper-evident bag TEB-0451 at 20:40 PST.
The paper Form 17B (Opening/Closing Log) shows the closing seal number for machine VV8K-7714 was handwritten as 'AC-9012'.
The digital entry made in the ElecTrack system at 20:41 PST for the closing seal number of machine VV8K-7714 is 'AC-9102'.
The discrepancy between the paper log (AC-9012) and the digital log (AC-9102) was automatically flagged by audit script 'AUD-SEAL-COMPARE-01' at 23:50 PST on Nov 5.
An unused seal with number AC-9102 was found in the precinct's 'Contingency Seals' envelope during the post-election supply inventory on November 6.
The physical seal currently attached to the transported machine VV8K-7714, as verified at the central counting facility, is AC-9012.
Aethelred County Board of Elections procedure manual, document ACBOE-PROC-2024.v3, section 7.4, requires dual entry of all seal numbers into both the paper log and the ElecTrack system.

Section 7.5 of ACBOE-PROC-2024.v3 requires a two-person verification for all seal applications, with both individuals initialing the paper log entry. The entry for seal 'AC-9012' has initials 'BW' and 'MF'.
Brenda Wallace was notified of the flagged discrepancy via email by the central office on November 6, 2024, at 09:15 PST and asked to provide a written statement explaining the data entry error.
